title: Timing verified. Texture still under review.
summary: Episode 8 passed its timing and file checks, but the new test still looks very close to the previous version. Soft texture remains. A separate synthetic-grain experiment is awaiting full-episode validation; no new version has been adopted.
problem: Fine texture can disappear as the picture is enlarged and compressed. The DVD also mixes useful detail with compression defects, so copying more of its signal can copy defects too.
response: The previous version remains the accepted reference. The new test passed episode 8 file checks, but subtle picture differences do not justify adoption. Later texture variants also remain experimental.
beforeDetail: Archived comparison, 31 October: the previous version in the episode 8 Orihime close-up.
afterDetail: Archived comparison, 31 October: the new test at the identical moment and crop. Differences remain subtle.
imageNote: 1 November dispatch: no newly cleared image pair. The featured record and image diary retain the 31 October comparison and all older examples; these are not new pictures.
stageNote: Step 3 of the four-step review cycle: episode 8 timing verified; visual benefit remains unproven.
nextStep: After episode 19 completion is reported, verify its timing and review pictures across the episode. Compare whether synthetic texture helps without disturbing outlines or motion before considering wider use.
